name: review-claude-skills
description: Personal collection of Claude Code review agents and skills, shared across devices.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Full-stack code/PR review agent covering correctness, security, best practices, and performance.

plugins.name: security-auditor
plugins.description: Traces authentication, authorization, cookies, input handling, and data exposure across the full request path. Finds security issues that span several files.

plugins.name: accessibility-reviewer
plugins.description: Checks keyboard use, focus, semantics, screen reader behavior, and RTL/LTR UI. Makes UI reviews more reliable and inclusive.

plugins.name: performance-profiler
plugins.description: Investigates measured slow paths, bundle size, rendering, network requests, and database queries. Focuses optimization on actual bottlenecks.

plugins.name: api-contract-reviewer
plugins.description: Checks request and response shapes, validation, errors, pagination, and frontend/backend compatibility. Prevents integration surprises.

plugins.name: angular-specialist
plugins.description: Reviews signals, RxJS, change detection, SSR, hydration, forms, and component boundaries. Gives your main stack a deeper review.

plugins.name: test-designer
plugins.description: Finds behavior that needs unit, integration, or end-to-end tests; writes tests for meaningful edge cases. Catches regressions the diff alone may miss.
